name: Manastorm Shadowfang Keep: solo Archmage Arugal cannot charm the only attacker with his kit's Curse of Arugal and keeps fighting
contract: Player report: in a solo Manastorm Shadowfang Keep run, Arugal mind-controlled the player with the kit's
Curse of Arugal 2102679 and the fight reset. Setup follows manastorm-arugal-solo-curse-no-evade-8345. A
second report (#12046) saw Arugal heal to full health while the player was charmed, so the case takes 15%
of his health first; an evade reset would bring him back to 100%.
Rule (2026-11-14): Archmage Arugal 4275 never mind-controls a player who fights him alone, even inside a group.
BossControlTargeting.h lets his charms, Arugal's Curse 7621 and the Ascension kit's Curse of Arugal 2102679
(both SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM on effect 0), land only while at least two players are on his threat list; his
SmartAI finds no target otherwise, and AscensionBossControlGuard refuses any other cast, a forced triggered one
included, with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS. The case selects Arugal and forces the charm with '.cast back <spell>
triggered' (select_nearby sends the CMSG_SET_SELECTION that ChatHandler::getSelectedCreature() needs) to probe
that guard. The closing assertions confirm the lone engaged player stays uncharmed and Arugal keeps fighting:
an evade would strip his Chaotic Link encounter aura 93459 (Unit::RemoveEvadeAuras()) and make him

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears its safety aura
CONTROL: the player is not charmed before Curse of Arugal is cast
CONTROL: Arugal's Chaotic Link encounter aura is present before the charm
Arugal is engaged and attackable ahead of the charm (setup is otherwise correct)
Wound Arugal so a reset to full health would be visible
CONTROL: Arugal is below full health before the charm
Select Arugal so '.cast back' can resolve him as the caster
Let a little real combat happen before forcing the cast
Give the forced cast time to resolve
Arugal cannot charm the only player fighting him: Curse of Arugal is refused
Arugal did not evade: his Chaotic Link encounter aura survives the refused charm
Arugal did not heal to full health
The player can still attack Arugal and finish the fight
